Friend, if you've been waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my Senate reelection campaign, today is that day – because there is still so much work to do to make a real, meaningful difference for people across Nevada and the country.
* If we're going to protect and restore reproductive freedom nationwide, I need your help.

* If we're going to take on powerful special interests to lower everyday costs for working families, I need your help.

* If we're going to take commonsense steps to prevent gun violence, I need your help.

* If we're going to uphold our democracy in the face of far-right attacks, I need your help.

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.

Hi friend,
I never intended to run for office. I never thought that politics was for someone like me.
I’m the daughter of a former union meat-cutter, a formerly unhoused single mother of two, and a survivor of gun violence, domestic violence, and sexual assault.
But when Michael Brown was killed by a white police officer in Ferguson, Missouri, in 2014, I couldn’t stand by. For more than 400 days, I stood shoulder to shoulder with our community as a nurse, as a pastor, and as an activist on the frontlines of the movement to save Black lives.
Our community was suffering, with parts of St. Louis seeing decades of underinvestment. It was clear that the status quo wasn’t working for our families, our children, and for regular, everyday people. So my community came together and asked me to run, and against all odds, I defeated a 52-year political dynasty. Not only that, but together, we made history. I became the first nurse and first Black woman to _ever_ represent Missouri in federal office.
**Since taking office in 2021, I’ve seen the power our movement holds.** When we come together, we’re a force of nature. I’ve been proud to testify before Congress about my personal abortion story, co-found the country’s first Equal Rights Amendment Caucus, introduce legislation to hold Republican insurrectionists accountable for trying to overthrow our democracy, took direct action on the steps of the U.S. Capitol to keep 11 million people housed, and introduced transformative legislation like a Green New Deal for Cities and the People’s Response Act, which takes a holistic approach to public safety. And I did all of that while delivering more than $2 billion and counting back home for everyday people in St. Louis, and passing over 25 pieces of legislation.
We can take on the establishment, we can bring billions of dollars home to our district, we can legislate to transform people’s lives, and we can push our **pro-peace, pro-humanity** movement into the national and international spotlight.
But to keep up this work, I need your help ensuring that my campaign has the resources to defeat far-right billionaires in the primary and all the way to November. In fact, one of my opponents is quietly taking donations from the same GOP donors who gave to Josh Hawley, Nikki Haley, and Donald Trump’s campaigns.

name: Tara, Miserable Cat Lady on Team Kaine
subject: My thoughts on JD Vance 🙃
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hi! I’m Tara, Tim Kaine’s Virginia Finance Director.
This is me with my cats, Ada (named after computer science pioneer Ada Lovelace) and Nikola (named after inventor and engineer Nikola Tesla).
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Contrary to what JD Vance thinks, I’m actually not miserable! Nor do I think I deserve less of a voice in our democracy than any other American — unlike Vance.
(Seriously — JD Vance has said in multiple recently resurfaced interviews that he thinks the Democratic Party is being run by “miserable childless cat ladies” and that people without kids have less of a stake in our country and should have less of a voice. Oh, and he thinks we should pay more taxes. Like, what?)
At first glance, those comments are so absurd that they’re funny.
But the thing is, he’s not joking .
And when someone who’s in the running to be our nation’s next Vice President says stuff like this, we have to listen to what he’s really saying. Here’s my best attempt at a translation:
Women have to be married and have kids to be happy and functioning members of our society. We should define who gets to vote based on their parental status. Cats are bad (??!!).
Meanwhile, he’s also trying to take control of how people become parents in the first place, with positions that threaten to limit both IVF and birth control, not to mention other reproductive care.
If you’ve read this far and you agree that we can’t let JD Vance anywhere near the Vice Presidency, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to our campaign here in Virginia. We’re working around the clock to make sure VA’s 13 electoral votes go to Kamala Harris, not the Trump-Vance ticket — and that we can re-elect Tim Kaine to the U.S. Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=250]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Look, everyone is entitled to their own views. You don’t like cats? Fine! But what you don’t get to do — especially when you’re in the running to lead this country! — is tell the American people that their personal reproductive choices make them less a part of our democracy. That’s just BS.
I’m all in to stop JD Vance from becoming our next Vice President, and I’m so proud that our team here in Virginia is building a massive voter outreach program to mobilize Democrats in every corner of the Commonwealth.
When we vote, we win — so if you can, please chip in to help us reach and turn out more voters! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks so much.
-Tara
Virginia Finance Director, Team Kaine

**July 28, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice Readers,
First of all, I'd like to extend my prayers to those affected by the wildfires across our great state right now. Here's the latest:

MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- Trump-Endorsed VA 05 Congressional District Republican Nominee, former Navy SEAL, Virginia Senator, and business owner John McGuire released the following statement on the results of Thursday's recount:

"This recount reaffirmed what we already knew from the June 18th primary. It really is amazing what we can achieve when we work as a team. It is an honor to be the VA 05 Republican nominee. I want to thank God and extend my sincere thanks to my family, to everyone who helped out on this campaign, to the people who endorsed and supported me, and to Donald J. Trump. Folks in the 5th District can rest assured that should they elect me in November, they will have an effective fighter in Congress who will get the job done. I look forward to working with Trump to defeat Kamala Harris and to helping elect Hung Cao in November. Now is the time to set our differences aside and unite as a party. Together we will Make America Great Again!"

Dear Friends & Supporters,
It's official. I'm running for State Senate in District 10, with the assumption that Congressman-elect Senator John McGuire, the Republican nominee for Congress in District 5, wins this November 2024.
Once McGuire wins this Republican leaning district, he will vacate his Virginia Senate seat creating an opening for me to run for Senate, representing District 10, where I now live. Currently, I now reside in Appomattox County.
I'm running for State Senate in a Special Election to be called by Governor Youngkin sometime this November 2024. The Special Election will take place January 2025.
Please make a donation today to send me back to the Virginia Senate, so that I may continue to serve you.
Any amount is greatly appreciated as I gear up to run for State Senate in Senate District 10, representing Amelia, Appomattox, Buckingham, Cumberland, Prince Edward, Fluvanna, Hanover, Goochland, Louisa and Powhatan.
The 10th Senatorial District is a very strong conservative Republican district. When I served the Virginia Senate from 2016 to 2023, my voting record was scored by many third party watchdog groups as one of the most conservative voting records in the Virginia Senate.
Many of you, live in the district, some of you do not. You can still give. You may or may not be able to vote for me, but I can still vote for you.
You know me. You know where I stand on the issues.
You saw me stand up against the 2021 gun grab, lead the charge against tyrannical covid mandates and confront politically correct politicians who refused to acknowledge that the 2020 presidential election was stolen.
Even when they put me in a plexiglass box because I refused to mask up and get the covid shot, I stood strong.
Despite the illegal censure by the Democrat controlled Senate of Virginia, I refused to compromise on boldly proclaiming the truth.
Please make a donation today to support my efforts to return to the Senate to be your voice.
A huge thanks to each of you who have already donated.
Please consider donating $25, $50 or $100 today. Thank you!

# Many Reasons for Hope
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter,
Our nation and the world face many problems today, some of which may seem overwhelming, but there are still reasons for hope. I'm running for Congress because I don't like the direction our country is headed. Open borders, crime, inflation, drugs, violent assaults, failing schools, contention in the Capitol, and a myriad of other problems have most Americans saying we are headed in the wrong direction. It can all sound quite bleak, but change starts with hope - the hope that you and I can still make a difference. Anne Frank wrote in her diary, "How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world." During a NATO assignment to Europe, I visited the home where Anne Frank wrote these words. Talk about bleak; Anne and her family had lost everything and were hiding from evil Nazis who wanted to capture and kill them. Yet, she was able to find reasons for hope. You and I have many more reasons to have hope. Despite our problems, we still live in the greatest country on earth. Prophets foretold of this "promised land" of freedom and opportunity. You and I have the privilege of deciding if we will "improve the world." It is as simple as being kind to someone, starting with our family, neighbors, and community. This is why I chose to run for the House of Representatives. According to our constitution, the President represents the entire country; senators represent their respective States. But it is the members of the House of Representatives who represent the people. As a Congressman, I can improve the world one person at a time. As one of 435 voices in Congress, I will fight to fix our country. I will not be able to solve all our nation's problems alone, but I can improve the lives of the people I represent in Boulder City, Henderson, and the east side of Las Vegas. If someone's Social Security check is missing - I'll represent them. If someone is having difficulty getting their Veteran benefits - I'll represent them. It will be my job to make sure the Federal government is working for the 750,000 people within Nevada's First Congressional District. To do this, I will be home in Henderson every weekend and whenever Congress is not in session. I will have a robust staff of caring people who live and work here in Southern Nevada. I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my District. Join Me in This Mission
We have a chance to make a real difference. As Ronald Reagan said, "You and I have a rendezvous with destiny. We will preserve for our children this, the last best hope of man on earth..." Your support is crucial. Every effort, whether volunteering, spreading the word, or donating, brings us closer to restoring our country's direction. Please reply to this email if you are willing to support our campaign. Together, we can change the direction of our country and bring positive change to our community and our nation. Thank you for your commitment and support.
*******

_Some of you receieved our Florida edition this morning instead of our national edition; we apologize for the delivery snafu._ **Good Morning**! On this day in 1884, [the cornerstone of the Statue of Liberty](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GK7CAUANCv0W7kejXqFBYPHulm2y2Do9eJi44hkYT9-4Wt9wcOnM_H8gillvfrIzTyI_clxFFOWtxtuqFeNE8-EyEpTl5aRGcmqS1fvY5g1B2JUKZA9ExgrDMpmoh3sC7z4hFQg4NJAkiw4o4hxClklSeLEhXTQKmMvouvXt5jpVy_-0m7iL3x6tcxtoOpfwxnhvN1XWJt6Sn6_mI4NxGOjam5MfVfameN47tP21VqLYexTMOrhVJ_qfHn6_T4EwAA__8hrE1-), a gift from France to the United States, was laid in a masonic ceremony on Bedloe's Island (now Liberty Island) in New York Harbor. You might say that the U.S. is now returning the Statue of Liberty favor with plans to include a [Tom Cruise skydiving stunt](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPpiAUAH8Ndhh8gmhBcY3dd-2Vhg8e-u5QDHAa__0mu1tuOckUk_nzWl6WIh3rb7ujqSEt1lW6cBm54iAX2XgTEAH7Bk2nAcZBdVI3m_GD1IOXGn3ohxGDBG871O8wqUG939CQAQFSjEJ1QnRCtxNY65QNfVAaOuiZFOipptz-TXTUDUN80oW5dWlvotlqPQvrfzGYGcz3fbdbivG5U_IZz5Trl8lgPvAuDOYVD8w28m-saecu_6eCvPx7PF3IT5up8BSf_SRXuIup0LFyhxn3dDy8g15Ng1STZDA32fjzphipDJpJse6W4mdb_XHUZeAjAAD__6NSbQM) in the Paris Olympics closing ceremony. _De rien, Paris!_ We hope you enjoyed reading today's _Flyover._ Let us know how we're doing by replying to this email. ## U.S. Urges Americans to Leave Lebanon
The U.S. Embassy in Lebanon is [encouraging Americans to leave](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGymzAQAL9GdOeRDoFwoSINndOmZA5xmEuE5EEyGf7-zXP96i12Z_88pgdJlPT8TTv7uuaJQpWTpwE6QDvZZvErM3LbsDcOceg7Y12zeTRIOtwJNTuenVtZU39frOWFe8d9Ix41Wj3ozmhttLvdkSh0tLZr59Bgq6zmRWo-bn-zpLrxGq988nELeW-i32p9FdX-UjgqHOvGm8T4zRSOrxwlXArHhVdOhRWOdjDamBbeBXifqZQLOIX8PujJBWjnQwKlApIg8kwpJ6gZItPJkBNQuqBK-McV6CSJNEcGKlA5FcmpwCEfTXP45fVfYpTSO2X1cyf5VDX1x32nx68AAAD__48UdH8) on "any ticket available" as concerns over an Israel-Hezbollah open war continue to mount, along with other escalations in the region. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Sunday that Israel is [already in a "multi-front war"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhDAQBOCngc6n9doGU7hIc92lTYkWWB8bmR_Z1p3y9hGpU45GI32ar8f4IEmyPz9p41DjMdJc5cWjV06hHW27hMiMbFoOukf0ndO2b9fQTaDRGRuZFoYB9RIH00W0E_ZWR99KQEALHpwG0NDfBiSaHUUTXY8aTWOBF6lHvn0fsteVY_o5Xpxv87G1Kay1nqUxHw3eG7zTufO7XNUVcpU5cYN3KZk4qZMSlyq70F7UShsV9aasrokCr8Cqy6LcZD2QmRCd8bzwPEQCN4CP6A2Y2OawnG9JSUrXNxaeG0n649R_v3kF_A0AAP__2K1jTA) with Iran and its proxies, as the U.S. and allies prepare to defend Israel. On Sunday, an Israeli airstrike reportedly killed dozens in Gaza, while a Palestinian militant [killed two Israelis in a knife attack](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGunDAQAL8GOiOzGAyFizR0lzYlWmB9bGJsZG8O3d8_3atfPSONNH8eywM5cHz-xpOc-LTgJvyiZVS9ArOYeneeCKirybUWYBz61tj6cOPeaWusmQB9t9M49NO4-nVa18F4S1vNDjQYPeq-1brVtpkAcevRd7630EJXGU07S8rN38RRDvLhnV6Umy2ddXCHyFWq7lcFcwXzfd-N8EkleS4ZKXysCuYUSe2Eu-rU8T-L4qiEck5ZFcF15fhU5cpEH3CkkKK6MFARjoxRoQhu_yirciRR61tdKfBGFcx1dvt1cwhcBlsZ_TyRv5u1_Ljp5eArAAD__6jIbUg), stoking more fears of a regional war.
## $4 Billion Settlement for Maui Fire Victims
A $4 billion settlement has been reached to resolve lawsuits stemming from [the deadly Maui wildfires of August 2023](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwDcEuKF7jLq_d0iJwie8K4whIrPz9ytGW2x1ppNHM-bouV0eJ8v2_29C2uC_ON3rhMnLNQS2qCzYiAg4dWmkAxouWynSrxTCKKKUWcZyGqGRUYHwQahoQjZpURxYEKDEKLYWQwvQTOOe1i0PUBiQMTAkM1PbSf--U24oxvfcXlt7vW5fs2tqjsuEfg5nBfBxHn28-41HPnMF8IoP5WfkvKX6jlGjPvGJrCTfMjRd0fsXAN_ekygO6kN48YG3l-TnKD0ohUsHKi89OXsBo2RUbHsdZVi-GKXHfHKXPrPano5eFnwAAAP__cVBqvw), which killed over 100 people and caused an estimated $5 billion in damages. The agreement involves seven defendants, including the state of Hawaii and Hawaiian Electric, and aims to [settle approximately 450 lawsuits](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8GtljwgIAHhi7e0rWj9QyPhAqbyEZG6ddX6dztpJNOuq_bfMNc8nb_xJV8S3XG0PJJs7uYC-hZ8-gTEZDi5KUFcFcjteUPbzHEaA0ukqIiMwIuY0A00i5OOel49iBACyeMFEIKO4yAGAwmlYwFCYppQTG3ug_fNW_tQam86kn7EOrKi3-09jyY-mAwMZh678OyhLdjMG3UDwYT7i2HQm8MFkZ4kfmxvfLdx2fPpeTjapkW9xVz-au2fxdPD78BAAD__yzyUsA) filed by homeowners and businesses. Governor Josh Green announced the deal, calling it a "historic settlement" that will help people heal without prolonged litigation. Currently, Maui is balancing tourism needs with [community healing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpDAQRL_GZCDTtjEXOLjE2Vx6IWpwe6ZPBo-MB8Tfn9hNNylV8KQqvb-P6YGceHv-wZVcjXnCpfJB09iaFvSkm-AiEZBqyPUWYBxMr23zcsFYHWJE0HFGwjDLuCyq1_OglDJzbNiBBC1HaXope2m7X4C4GIwqGgs9KKElBa65dP8yb_VFMV35oNIteW2Se9X63oX6LcAL8Od5dp8daw543YAAv9dcLgG-FjwoCfAbnbsAf88K8HK8424rfrj9plrcNj6o7Fiu9uQUIhcS4K0ewKhRS2kF-Ka48D45Jd4HK7R8rsjp61b90dHh4H8AAAD__zYwZ2U), urging visitors to support local businesses and volunteer while respecting the island's ongoing recovery process.
## Affordable Vacation Home Spots in the U.S.
Some amazing vacation spots in the U.S. still offer homes at reasonable prices, according to [a new list published by House Beautiful](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHOnDAQBp_GdEZmAS8pXKShu7Qp0WIW2MhghA3o3j66q__--2ak-fsaXiRB9uUPbezyHAfyWW4eOt1qaIammNzMDFwX7CoE6GxbNVisrkOa0bYjddih9xMwdh4ra0fAsTZUiAMDjelMWxlTGSx_AZFvaa7nFqGCWjWGJ8nxLP9F2fPKc3jHm8_Sx60Ibs35SKr-raBX0D_PU67xSjwyXVnmK3xmCvqJkyy7lj0dclKWuCvoT6agOWXKrKBfbIVoa2s-nJVP1jnq8XprvzId-ib__ek1bpz0lRT0xemm45EQJFlUjVk2kq-xyD9Wuh38DwAA__9iDGqz). Topping the list is [Hocking Hills, Ohio](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuhSAUgOGnge2awxFEB4YubrdrR4Nw0NOi3CjR9O2bdu7-50--j-f09Jx5X979Rq6mMvlQ-aKpf5gH6knL6BIRUivJKYvYd0ZpK1dn536OKgzKQOyUiQNBMtZ0bQozIHjJDgE19GAUgALbDOh9MD61yVhU2AoNFLmWo_ksvNeVUv4uFx1NKJvMbq31dYr2TeAocLzvu1lL-OJ9WTnn8zcSOMrDxdfNOfPZWaFh2Tznv0H9V3M5_AkAAP__ZZ1L0w), where the median sale price for a home is $250,000. At number two, [Finger Lakes, New York](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszz1urDAQAODT2N0ie_zHFi5eQ7evTYkGGMMkBq-MBcrtI6XOAb7i-3iNL-TMx_ofd4otlRHnxheN_cM9wI5WLjERARlJUQeA3jttg9yisRAmbSc_B1qMf6p-QvC9T25ymLSXHEGBVb1yWimtQvcExNlhMskF0GCEVbRwK7X7LHy0jVL-LhfVbi67zHFr7X0K80_AIGC477tLfKxUM37R2ZW6Chhkjcv75pz59EFYte7I-de3PzNXhJ8AAAD___erS0M), boasts a median price of just under $200,000. Six other destinations range from the Pacific Northwest to the Gulf Coast--all either very close to or far below the national median home price of $442,479.

# MONDAY, AUGUST 5, 2024
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1870, the International Railroad Company received a charter to build a line from the south bank of the Red River near Fulton, Arkansas, to Laredo and ultimately to Mexico by way of Austin. Today, we're covering two astronauts who attend the same church and are currently aboard the International Space Station, along with an update on the orphaned baby bird that was [wrapped in a tortilla](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPozAQhX-N6YzswSakcHENXa69Ejn2ACM5NmcmIfn3K3bbbZ5e8Unv6ft3m26eEuXlr3-g4_dcJh-YXjgN0kowk2miu6t41Q06fQEYemWuplmdsRjNHGZruuHS6z6A19Zg1LM1vbFdQw4UGDUoq5XtwbY4hNDHGHzXob7Od2EURuJSW16R8e33OX3KC2sbyqNJbmXedtH9ETAKGI_jaDMee1h9zpi0OikB4zkiYFTDGSBgXEqJ8iTlM9P_J8qdS_3IBTNWz5QXuT-3rVSWB6UoD9x_WqIZZcXV3ykRe6aSZcDMWAWMTXVxOygl2vuLMGp5eErfP_l3ay8HXwEAAP__e2VxcQ) to keep it warm. ## Business Still Without Power 4 Weeks After Beryl

Friend,

I don't know how else to say this, but you're my only hope.

A new list of the most vulnerable Senate seats in 2024 was just announced, and my seat in Texas is marked among the _**[TOP"most likely to flip."](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1m7oa2kgur2ce89vi1q8hhm8e61p160mnvbipm0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c3jm8o74cth2bs)**_

body:
With all the worries about food shortages, power outages, and natural disasters

**Our warehouse is overloaded with food kits... and YOU WIN!** With all the worries about food shortages, power outages, and natural disasters, it's no wonder our insanely popular 4Patriots 3-Month Survival Food Kits have sold out over and over again! So, we asked our warehouse manager, Matt, to make all the 3-Month Survival Food Kits possible. And holy cow, did he deliver! However, an enormous batch has arrived at our warehouse, all at once, and now we are swamped with inventory. Our pain is your gain. Yup, we're practically bribing you to take 'em off our hands. When you [**stock up today with this exclusive deal**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl502fr24a7g0ih44u3e4b4o44rnkifl1k6gg4s8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c3jm4pr2c5h2bs), you'll be helping a family-owned American business save some severe warehousing costs. And we'll gladly pass those savings on to you along with a boatload of FREE GOODIES! [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdcan3ljlle2pao6ocbcvgkh6snb65j446q32un8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c3jm4pr2c5h2bs) [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zce70ugcauk8ua6kdb72o6af19osfp1ggnckr7kg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c3jm4pr2c5h2bs) **4Patriots Survival Food Kits are a tremendous value. This is not ordinary food.** This is delicious, nutritious, good-for-25-years super survival food that helps keep you from going hungry in a crisis. This is high-quality survival food without gross fillers or weird "frankenfood" that the other guys use to pad their survival meals. They are handpacked right in a family-owned facility in the U.S.A. and you won't believe how inexpensive these kits are. These Survival Food Kits now contain more delicious food than ever before. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9hfehrc6dekimjuhbvri1as03jrt9ibfuetof28_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c3jm4pr2c5h2bs) **More Raving Customer Reviews!** **Rory H.**
"I was surprised to find that the densely packed packages were easy to prepare and were tasty as well. I definitely recommend having survival food on hand for the times when 'life' happens while we are planning other things." **Billy H.**
"Received my food kit, and I was able to make the potato soup on my cookstove. Just needed boiling water. Gave it a good stir and let it simmer. When I opened up the pot, it smelled so good. You can see the chunks of potatoes and carrots in each bite you take. It's a good soup." **Kevin S.**
"The 72 hour kit is a perfect starter kit for any scenario. Put one in your car, work bag, in your house or RV. If you want to start preparing safe food, this is where to start." **Carol B.**
"I have been iced in this weekend. I thought I would try my potato soup. To my utter delight, IT WAS DELICIOUS. Thank you for such a wonderful product and the peace of mind it brings." **Ken K.**
"I am not a full-blown survivalist. I am not an idiot, either. I have been through enough in my life and have seen friends who have been through an emergency situation. Save up if you have to, but get at least a month's supply. It tastes good. Although if it's a dire of an emergency, you will be happy to eat anything. IF you have something to eat for your family. We made some of this product, and had family and friends over for them to taste. They all agreed they didn't think anything would be this good, and they will be ordering. Just do something. You can't miss out on this deal." **Justin A.**
"My wife and I tried the food and we were both surprised about how good it tasted and how satisfied it made us feel afterwards. It feels good knowing that I can provide for my family if a crisis arose and I intend to get more in the future. Also the shipping and customer service has been top notch. This is probably the cheapest survival food I have found, and the company is great." **Gary M.**
"I actually had lost my job and was homeless for a while. I dug into my food supply, and I cannot fully describe how delicious and easy to prepare everything is. I felt like I was eating like a king. I am going to stock up again as soon as I settle into my new job. Everyone should participate with this company. You will not be disappointed." **John H.**
"We're in Florida and have made many preparations for the aftermath of a possible hurricane. While we are thankful that Florida has not been hit in several years, it gives us great peace of mind to know we have our 4Patriots kit stashed away, knowing it's not a case of "if" but "when"." body:
If Texas falls to the Left, so too does America.

Friend,

I don't know how else to say this, but you're my only hope.

A new list of the most vulnerable Senate seats in 2024 was just announced, and my seat in Texas is marked among the _**[TOP"most likely to flip."](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjk13s0bu161o844fot5sjapa629v0fcqj7jp2jo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c3jm4pr2clh2bs)**_

[Source: _CNN_]

_Some of you receieved our Florida edition this morning instead of our national edition; we apologize for the delivery snafu._ **Good Morning**! On this day in 1884, [the cornerstone of the Statue of Liberty](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQgOGngS3oOLAhA0Olylu6drTAnG0qCJaNbPXtq3TP8o-f9H8_xodPOT2XL1_ItbmOfmrppDG_Ym_dDfWoeXQzEZLi5KRBtAaMlnx1du5RKtDeWxsCdn0wQcWJiEAZr4knh4AaLHQSAaQSgcDITtMk5d3g3TANFFOru_ip6dlWmvNvPWkXUy08u7W17WDqg-HAcLiuS6wlBlH3heFQhD82pobC1KfU1vSW7y5uV8o5Hf2LXopP-Z9q7-dOh38BAAD__6teUWI), a gift from France to the United States, was laid in a masonic ceremony on Bedloe's Island (now Liberty Island) in New York Harbor. You might say that the U.S. is now returning the Statue of Liberty favor with plans to include a [Tom Cruise skydiving stunt](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvvSAUBfBPoxsGrvCUgeG_uL3_2tEgXvS2KAaoxm_fvLZrl5Oc5Ay_nLfn-LQUaF_-2w1N8XG0rtCJY3hFzxQDOcp6Nh4RsK3RiA6g73gnRb2ah9bCCwl-mvQkW2cBpNK99FrNvu_bmgxwkLznSgDnom0m5J1QEp0QugPdVZLjTCWm5j3SXlb04Y4npsbFrQ5mLeXIVfuvgqGC4bquZo0h3FeMc8IjpvKzrGDY8coVDAvumGxgv7XEjbn0SRlZ_rhnOpEdNlFmMdzbQS4zF2KmfWEOE25xv5mAVumHVFpWMNTJzMdFIVB-vKzLZil828rfb50GvgIAAP__gnJwCw) in the Paris Olympics closing ceremony. _De rien, Paris!_ We hope you enjoyed reading today's _Flyover._ Let us know how we're doing by replying to this email. ## U.S. Urges Americans to Leave Lebanon
The U.S. Embassy in Lebanon is [encouraging Americans to leave](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGynDAQRE8D2WxJg0AQKHBC9p06pAYxWsYW0hbSx8XtXbu5k0466H7v19fyRRIlPX_Swa6GvJCvcvES3zFCD2gW024uMCN3LTttEUerrNHt7kYegsdOTSEY1EZjUNu4jnaYVjv1Q9-KQ4VGjarXqJTuHisrq3vDXuvJ4mQbo3iTms_H7yyp7hzinS8-Hz4fbXR7ra_SdD8anBuc6867xPjuGpxfOYq_G5w3DpwKNzibUSutO_guwMdKpdzAyefvk55cgA4-xVMqIAkir5RygpohMl0MOQGlG6r4P1yBLpJIa2SgApVTkZwKnPKZaU-3vf5KjFKGN8HzIPm8auv_HV4O_wUAAP__jWJ3Zw) on "any ticket available" as concerns over an Israel-Hezbollah open war continue to mount, along with other escalations in the region. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Sunday that Israel is [already in a "multi-front war"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uwzAMBOCnsTcFFEXH8qChS7Z07WgwMhWzkH9gCQn69oW7dyFAHA74cF_38c6adX1-8iKhpm3kWPUlYz6PN51BGqmdQhJBca0E2yP6Hnqy7Rw4eqaryJSsY7oyW_IDRLFJrKUpthoQkMBDZxHAustDoLcdSbR26HHoGwKZtG7H5XvTtc6S8s_2kuMSt6XNYa51L437aPDW4I33Vd7ljM7nqBqzNHjTcrBks3OWUnVVXouZeeFi3nyYs2LAGyBzWkz3IA_sHoid8zJJHBJDN4BP6B241B5h2t-as5bryXsurPmPU_8f6BXwNwAA__8WUmf0) with Iran and its proxies, as the U.S. and allies prepare to defend Israel. On Sunday, an Israeli airstrike reportedly killed dozens in Gaza, while a Palestinian militant [killed two Israelis in a knife attack](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOpDAQRL8GMiO7bc4QOLiEbC69EBncDL1rbGT3Dpq_X7H5JpVUSfX0_j_mh6dI6fnPH-h4y7NfmV44xzsG0Qsws2mD2xABdYtOWYDBSmtUuzur9Tb2akEbTFgXbQfb21HJAJvXpseWHEgwcpC9AimV7haUVvUGV6VGC6NtjMRAnEv3kSnxjlt85xeWbs1HG93OfNZG_21gamC6rqtjOrDmjWrxGO9VA1NOKAL6ILTYvwoLSoKxlFxEZb8slJ6ingXxLvYccxKnj1iZEvkkPLNfP7GIumcWy1ucOdKKDUxtceG8KEaqf27S5-Hp57Pl3129HHwHAAD__91ycJw), stoking more fears of a regional war.
## $4 Billion Settlement for Maui Fire Victims
A $4 billion settlement has been reached to resolve lawsuits stemming from [the deadly Maui wildfires of August 2023](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAQhZ8GOiN7sDEpXNyGLrfdEvlnCLMyJrIdUN5-RbTtNqNPGunoO-frPt8tRUqP_3ZDU5d9tr7SgXO8zsgUAznLNpgFEbBv0QgNMGqupWhXM0hwgx0dqOB8r9QgLOejXAL0Dqy9tWSAg-QjVwI4F33nkGuhJHohbhpuupEcA9U9d987pbriEt_7gbnz-9ZGs9b6LE3_r4Gpgek8zy45n_As17-B6cIGpldhvySZoxhpT6xgrRE3TJVltH7FwDb7osIC2hDfLGCp-fVpy06KYaGMhWWfrBhAK9FmE57nFVaGS_OxWYofrfr3UIeBnwAAAP__OMxuwQ), which killed over 100 people and caused an estimated $5 billion in damages. The agreement involves seven defendants, including the state of Hawaii and Hawaiian Electric, and aims to [settle approximately 450 lawsuits](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FuhDAQRL_G7g551-YMhYs0dJc2JbLNcmxk8AksrMvXR6RPMxpppHl6X4_x4Tnx9vz0K7ky59HHwieN6Yru1t7QjEZObiZC0pIcWMTOKmtALq4LgWarewIfFd21DrGH0IGeIlhQs2SHCo3qVAuoFOgmkLLQGooAvcXeCqNo4pL35jvzVhaa0zuftDcxrzK5pZTXIfSHwEHgUGttQojXJnDYqB4CB78XjomuGi32-Kb2x9Ysdze9KqfEx_2iPFfP6e-1_O95OvwNAAD__6STVks) filed by homeowners and businesses. Governor Josh Green announced the deal, calling it a "historic settlement" that will help people heal without prolonged litigation. Dear Peter,
In a recent interview with CBS News, Bobby perfectly captured the immense challenges we have faced during this campaign with one powerful quote:
“They've written rules to make it nearly impossible for anybody like me to run.”
**Yet,[thanks to you and your unwavering support](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=thanks_to_you_8_5_24_rs_nd1&n=3), we have overcome every challenge that has come our way.**
After Ross Perot's run in 1992, the established parties conspired to erect barriers designed to crush any future independent challengers. Despite their relentless efforts to stifle competition and maintain their grip on power, **you stood with us.**
Even when we encountered outdated laws and inconsistent information from various Secretaries of State, **your resolve never wavered**. Your belief in this movement pushed us forward, even when the odds seemed insurmountable.
Through your tireless efforts, [we gathered over a million signatures for state ballot access](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=thanks_to_you_8_5_24_rs_nd1&n=4), a monumental feat compared to the 340,000 signatures Ross Perot needed.
And because of your financial support,we’ve raised an incredible $52 million, making this the most successful independent campaign in history.
Your hard work, dedication, and generosity made this possible, proving that when we unite, we can achieve the impossible.
**Thank you for being a part of this historic movement.**
You’re not only challenging the status quo but also laying the foundation for a future where every voice matters.
[And we know we can count on you to continue standing with us through election day.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=thanks_to_you_8_5_24_rs_nd1&n=5)

| **Legislative Update**
In July 2024, several key pieces of legislation passed through Congress with Representative Luttrell voting in favor of each. H. Res. 1371, condemning the Biden Administration and Vice President Kamala Harris for not securing the border, passed narrowly with a vote of 220 to 196. The House also approved H.R. 8098, the Department of Interior and Related Agencies Appropriations, by a slim margin of 210 to 205. An overwhelmingly supported H. Res. 1367, establishing a task force to investigate the attempted assassination of Donald Trump, passed 416 to 0. However, H. Res. 1344, finding Attorney General Merrick Garland in contempt of Congress for disobeying a subpoena, failed with a vote of 204 to 210. H. J. Res. 165, expressing Congressional disapproval of the Department of Education’s programs and activities, passed 210 to 205. H.R. 8772, the Legislative Branch Appropriations, failed to pass, with a vote of 205 to 213. On voter eligibility, H.R. 8281, which requires proof of citizenship to vote, was approved 223 to 198. Additionally, H.R. 7700, aimed at stopping unaffordable dishwasher standards, and H.R. 7637, advocating for refrigerator freedom, passed with votes of 234 to 193 and 212 to 192, respectively. **In each case, Representative Luttrell voted in favor.**

By: John Williams
The upcoming 2024 Presidential election presents Americans with a historically defining choice: a crossroads to either fully embrace socialism or return to the founding principles of our Constitutional Republic. With Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party openly campaigning on socialist policies, it is vital to understand the dangers of embracing socialism by looking at the failed examples in other countries, like Venezuela, and the ongoing uprising against their socialist dictator, Nicolas Maduro.
Venezuela serves as a stark reminder of the perils of socialism. Once a prosperous nation with the largest proven oil reserves in the world, Venezuela fell into economic ruin and political turmoil under the leadership of Hugo Chavez and his successor, Nicolas Maduro. The socialist policies implemented by these leaders, including nationalization of industries, wealth redistribution, and increased government control, resulted in hyperinflation, shortages of basic necessities, and a crumbling economy.
The Venezuelan people, tired of the oppressive regime and the devastating consequences of socialism, have joined together in an ongoing uprising to overthrow Maduro. Their fight for freedom and a chance to rebuild their country reflects the desperation and suffering caused by socialist policies.
The lessons from Venezuela should not be ignored. Embracing socialism would mean risking economic collapse, loss of personal freedoms, and a decline in our quality of life. The promises of equality and fairness that socialism offers often come at the expense of individual liberty and economic growth. In truth, socialism always degenerates into a kleptocracy where the political elite become economic leaches on the society that they rule.
Returning to our Constitutional roots is crucial in preserving the principles that have made the United States a beacon of freedom and prosperity. The Founding Fathers designed a system that emphasized limited government intervention, protection of individual rights, and a free-market economy. It is through these principles that America has achieved unparalleled success and progress throughout its history.
Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party openly advocate for socialist policies like Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, the free movement of people across borders and higher taxes on the wealthy. While these policies may sound appealing on the surface, they would have detrimental effects on our economy and individual liberties. Medicare for All, for instance, would lead to longer wait times, reduced quality of care, and massive tax burdens on hardworking Americans. The Green New Deal, with its ambitious and unrealistic goals, would stifle economic growth, destroy jobs, and burden taxpayers with exorbitant costs.
By electing someone like Kamala Harris and embracing socialist policies, we risk losing the foundation upon which our nation was built. It is essential to remember that the United States thrives when individuals are empowered to succeed through their own efforts and innovation. The government should play a limited role, allowing for free markets and individual freedoms to flourish.
Returning to our Constitutional roots means upholding the values and principles that have guided our nation for centuries. It means safeguarding individual liberty, promoting economic growth, and preserving the checks and balances that ensure our government remains limited and accountable.
As we observe the struggles of the Venezuelan people against their socialist dictator, let us be reminded of the dangers of embracing socialism. We must choose a path that leads to prosperity, freedom, and the preservation of our Constitutional principles.
In the 2024 Presidential election, it is crucial that we reject the openly socialist agenda put forth by Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party. Instead, let us choose a leader like Donald Trump. Though not perfect, Donald Trump will fight to uphold our Constitution, champion free markets, and protect individual liberties. This is the path that will secure a brighter future for our nation and ensure that the mistakes of failed socialist experiments are not repeated on American soil.

"The 72 hour kit is a perfect starter kit for any scenario. Put one in your car, work bag, in your house or RV. If you want to start preparing safe food, this is where to start." **Carol B.**
"I have been iced in this weekend. I thought I would try my potato soup. To my utter delight, IT WAS DELICIOUS. Thank you for such a wonderful product and the peace of mind it brings." **Ken K.**
"I am not a full-blown survivalist. I am not an idiot, either. I have been through enough in my life and have seen friends who have been through an emergency situation. Save up if you have to, but get at least a month's supply. It tastes good. Although if it's a dire of an emergency, you will be happy to eat anything. IF you have something to eat for your family. We made some of this product, and had family and friends over for them to taste. They all agreed they didn't think anything would be this good, and they will be ordering. Just do something. You can't miss out on this deal." **Justin A.**
"My wife and I tried the food and we were both surprised about how good it tasted and how satisfied it made us feel afterwards. It feels good knowing that I can provide for my family if a crisis arose and I intend to get more in the future. Also the shipping and customer service has been top notch. This is probably the cheapest survival food I have found, and the company is great." **Gary M.**
"I actually had lost my job and was homeless for a while. I dug into my food supply, and I cannot fully describe how delicious and easy to prepare everything is. I felt like I was eating like a king. I am going to stock up again as soon as I settle into my new job. Everyone should participate with this company. You will not be disappointed." **John H.**
"We're in Florida and have made many preparations for the aftermath of a possible hurricane. While we are thankful that Florida has not been hit in several years, it gives us great peace of mind to know we have our 4Patriots kit stashed away, knowing it's not a case of "if" but "when"." body:
Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.| | | [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=616a1b2046b5433fb083d834da7e6fcd&_e=HkREKYhwozaXpvmZTFDD7L2jU27D9sn_dg65vLNebJMxZhk8i_yFgipe8Xu9QqE1YjzN8zZyel12DKdkun5uPGMfvUbMZiVahb1Hxzhihg3zt0jEien5ODa7Ju3NGQxwUG6GD8wV_JCR5ts1WPsxhcsFl-vO4uNL-Ee0WGRCM3c1_GQilAB7BSfCMvh0dYYPAXAUVwSLh_NwmAPdSCOlLpnkZbqj0vgUvLw9e_jygBfHDfsgST-llNt6AtNG9_zawV5YmVoAKNlJNEj6-8NieA%3D%3D)
---
|

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=616a1b2046b5433fb083d834da7e6fcd&_e=HkREKYhwozaXpvmZTFDD7L2jU27D9sn_dg65vLNebJMxZhk8i_yFgipe8Xu9QqE1YjzN8zZyel12DKdkun5uPGMfvUbMZiVahb1Hxzhihg3zt0jEien5ODa7Ju3NGQxwXCgF6BNzuQYbqJkYYF_pScUpcwavyRYXSqkTZBNgpEfaS1imwr7EnGuCFxtQtd8QJu6HmHXYCxkNvlmbuxnzX4kGGLqb7ubEoS2rsCU4sxlYKepNgAOn-rndYXonsVQV_H6uwhkCpLa3xEU_tpJL2g%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=616a1b2046b5433fb083d834da7e6fcd&_e=HkREKYhwozaXpvmZTFDD7L2jU27D9sn_dg65vLNebJMxZhk8i_yFgipe8Xu9QqE1YjzN8zZyel12DKdkun5uPGMfvUbMZiVahb1Hxzhihg3zt0jEien5ODa7Ju3NGQxwxPAcv_RJNTNQrY_A267QEJYMLTUUqn3SljJVQQ3EM8udXpn0RxpF2-dpUhErqJ_R6XPiHapwnARd1f1ZvXoV4DmF0SstP-Md7VQNvm6hRQspBBXiQByE3eTxRUpTAqREEyJvNvBlVtD2i_5cdI7fmw%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=616a1b2046b5433fb083d834da7e6fcd&_e=HkREKYhwozaXpvmZTFDD7L2jU27D9sn_dg65vLNebJMxZhk8i_yFgipe8Xu9QqE1YjzN8zZyel12DKdkun5uPGMfvUbMZiVahb1Hxzhihg3zt0jEien5ODa7Ju3NGQxw9_ve8fkO2HBo4WcqGuycECy2l_wrNRBJnth9fF39BtMsKrzv1U1NYoBKxkboBGiuSfi1fecUdFHEbeE7-iEJuUKf-5bo7NgDM4CsTYpdujZcu9tpU4NyKrItVcqHuewxVkwWH4EFOqTVDNZgO8LSTQ%3D%3D)

body:

Between our staff and volunteers, we've knocked on 30,000 doors, made 200,000 phone calls, held over 100 events, and logged 40,000 miles traversing this massive district - because no one will work harder to earn your vote.
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]
This is our 30,000th door. Believe it!
My team and I made it a huge priority to connect directly with voters because it isn't just about winning. It's about listening and understanding issues.
JOIN OUR FIGHT [drbob.me/aboutbob]
Friends,
Tomorrow is the day, Election Day!
If you're able this morning, we're entirely funded by grassroots contributions from everyday people, and we sure could use a fundraising boost. [drbob.me/aboutbob]
Imagine the resources involved knocking this many doors. We are drained. Your generosity has gone a long, long way, but, we're not done yet!
We cannot take anything for granted, because, in the end, there's only one number that matters — the final vote tally.
Our focus is on winning, winning for hardworking, everyday people.
If you put your faith in me tomorrow and this November, I'll be able to build coalitions in the House to champion rural life and use subject-matter expertise to solve problems.
This campaign has always been about the people and how attention to issues — and a Congressperson who gives a damn — can make life better for everyone.
Let's win this!
Friends, from the bottom of my heart, thank you for your generosity, loyalty, and support. It means more than you know. Now, let's get out the vote! Let's win this!
-Bob

| Greetings!
It's that time of year again -- when Democrats share their talking points with the mainstream media, influencers, and members of Congress to begin attacking conservative candidates.
One such attack you've probably heard about recently relates to Project 2025. Democrats are claiming that Project 2025 is radical and that no one in America would agree with its agenda.
However, a recent poll shows voters in battleground states are in favor of many ideas found in Project 2025 -- specifically when it comes to issues that impact families and children.
Here are a few findings from the poll:

* Should biological males who identify as women be allowed to compete in women's sports events? 75% NO, 12% YES

* If a student wants to change his or her gender, name, and pronouns, should teachers and schools be required to notify the student's parents? 69%, YES, 21% NO

* Should it be against the law to provide children under 18 with puberty blockers, drugs, and / or surgery to help them transition from one gender to another? 71% YES, 22% NO

* Should public schools teach young children that biological males can become girls and that biological girls can become boys? 73% NO, 16% YES

---
| None of this is a surprise. Parents have made their views on these issues extremely clear: leave our kids alone.
[Would you join our effort to reach 7 million swing voters to help put President Trump back in the White House and take back the majority in the Senate?](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QCUciFJQp7VrW0183KBel0qVKm6R8KHmcPCeYSzWtby8CaHIDCnUdK7Jj7JeMV-C5kDZWJphWxaaqUojbB-YFW76QYfrUcCFLOYBnUIhFQpv4RwZL6Nf6aQD-TLqkZCBCQ5eUDYqp88pwJum_EHL3UguIuzwWfQuJR0JNhVFueuskrmqt9Ih1BN3lfoaX-AEJcmBD9NdiUebJ30ywRCBIGF0UD4RSwGMtyDcTJEhoKA=&c=QBDfC4GuH3Zh3z1hGm4OnArG29DQwvoPjQNAcyPTdmy98lK_rzh_3g==&ch=MMl0SvS1j9kWysiNvMq8upSqUaH6_3mehETDOh-kjYcyUu7AQSdglA==)
That's why APP is hyper focused on injecting these issues into the 2024 election as part of our Every Family Votes initiative.
We launched this $18 million campaign last week, in response to Kamala Harris's HQ account calling us out after my meeting with President Trump, and we have a response to Kamala and the woke Democrats attacking our kids.
[The Big Family is coming for you. ](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QCUciFJQp7VrW0183KBel0qVKm6R8KHmcPCeYSzWtby8CaHIDCnUdK7Jj7JeMV-C5kDZWJphWxaaqUojbB-YFW76QYfrUcCFLOYBnUIhFQpv4RwZL6Nf6aQD-TLqkZCBCQ5eUDYqp88pwJum_EHL3UguIuzwWfQuJR0JNhVFueuskrmqt9Ih1BN3lfoaX-AEJcmBD9NdiUebJ30ywRCBIGF0UD4RSwGMtyDcTJEhoKA=&c=QBDfC4GuH3Zh3z1hGm4OnArG29DQwvoPjQNAcyPTdmy98lK_rzh_3g==&ch=MMl0SvS1j9kWysiNvMq8upSqUaH6_3mehETDOh-kjYcyUu7AQSdglA==)

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. Literally.

My Democrat opponent has a lot of pressure on his back. His colleagues in the Senate, along with every left-wing news outlet in the country, are pinning their hopes of maintaining their majority on his reelection in Montana.

Alarms are beginning to sound everywhere. Some news outlets are even penning articles with headlines like, _**"The Fate of the Senate Depends on Jon Tester.**_ "

You'd think that with all the pressure to save his party's Senate majority, he'd embrace the candidacy of the newly minted Democrat nominee for president, Kamala Harris. 1. Jon Tester won't publicy endorse Kamala Harris.
2. You have yet to endorse me in my bid to unseat the Democrat who will decide the "_fate of the Senate_ "

My opponent refuses to endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States because he knows the Biden-Harris Administration has wrecked the U.S. economy and destroyed our borders.

Jon Tester also knows that by endorsing Kamala Harris for president, he immediately loses any chance of winning reelection.

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I ran; by night, my colleagues **[many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft.** The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, it’s
official: we have just one day left to save Rep. Cori Bush’s seat in
Congress from a phony Democratic challenger taking millions from AIPAC and
other far-right megadonor groups.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240805-1-cb.pypajr&refcode=em20240805-35879&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35879%2E1203867%2EGSW4H5 ]Can you rush $5 between Cori’s campaign and Justice
Democrats right NOW to help keep our ads on the air and get out the vote
before tomorrow's primary?

At this point, our opponents have spent more than $13.5 million across
Missouri’s 1st district attacking Cori with lies and making her opponent
out to be something he’s not: a progressive champion for the people of St.
Louis.

Wesley Bell claims he’s a Ferguson activist, but the truth is, he’s the
prosecutor who made broken promises to Michael Brown’s family and the
community of Ferguson to climb the political ladder and then failed to
hold Darren Wilson accountable or create real reform.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240805-1-cb.pypajr&refcode=em20240805-35879&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35879%2E1203867%2EGSW4H5 ]Tweet from Heather Lindsy: The audacity of Wesley Bell claiming he was
a Ferguson activist in his ads while running to unseat OUR Ferguson
activist is just beyond! The BIG money behind his campaign keeps me
donating $3, $15, $30 small amts when I can so the exchange commission
reports show PEOPLE not PACs

But Cori? Cori is the real deal. A nurse, pastor, and community activist,
Cori has the experience in both the St. Louis community and in Congress to
back up the fact that she’s a true champion for working people, criminal
justice reform, and human rights. As Bernie Sanders put it:

“She has lived the struggles regular, everyday people endure and her
mission since being elected is to do the very most for her community —
starting with those who have the very least.”

As we approach the 10th anniversary of Michael Brown’s death at the hands
of police, Cori has released her final ad of this campaign to give
Michael’s family a platform and set the record straight on Bell’s broken
promises. The powerful ad is making waves, as noted by Politico:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240805-1-cb.pypajr&refcode=em20240805-35879&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=35879%2E1203867%2EGSW4H5 ]Politico: MO-01 — Democratic Rep. Cori Bush features the father and
sister of Michael Brown, who was killed by a police officer in 2014. “I
feel like he lied to us,” Mike Brown Sr. said of Bush’s primary opponent
Wesley Bell, the St. Louis county prosecutor. “He used my family for
power, and now he’s trying to sell out St. Louis,” he added. ... Justice
Democrats, the progressive group backing Bush, pushes back against
“Republican lies” attacking Bush. ... United Democracy Project, the American
Israel Public Affairs Commitee’s super PAC, says that Bush “has her own
agenda” as “Democrats need to stick together to get things done” in a
closely divided Congress.

If we want to achieve justice and progress for all, we can’t let a liar
and hypocrite like Bell replace one of our fiercest progressive voices in
Congress.

Cori is being dramatically outspent by Republican millionaires and
corporate special interests who want to see Bell defeat her, so we’re
coming to you in these final 24 hours of the primary to ask for your
much-needed grassroots support.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240805-1-cb.pypajr&refcode=em20240805-35879&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=35879%2E1203867%2EGSW4H5 ]Please pitch in $5 or anything you can afford to fuel
our efforts to get out the vote for Cori before MO-01 voters cast their
ballots TOMORROW!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240805-1-cb.pypajr&refcode=em20240805-35879&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=35879%2E1203867%2EGSW4H5 ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240805-35879-footer&t=1024&refcode2=35879_1203867_GSW4H5&akid=35879%2E1203867%2EGSW4H5

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. Peter,

This morning, I’m testifying in a pivotal case to guarantee the fairness of our courts in Mississippi.

Filed by the American Civil Liberties Union, ACLU of Mississippi, Southern Poverty Law Center, and the New York-based law firm Simpson Thacher & Bartlett, this lawsuit seeks to rectify the lack of representation for Black voters in Mississippi’s Supreme Court districts. Currently, all three districts are majority-white, and they were last updated in 1987 despite objections from Black legislators.

Current districts violate the Voting Rights Act and the U.S. Constitution by diluting Black voting strength. Mississippi, where approximately 38% of our population is Black, has seen only four Black justices serve on its Supreme Court, never more than one at a time. The current court consists of eight white justices and one Black justice, underscoring the disparities highlighted in the lawsuit.

As a candidate for the U.S. Senate, I am committed to ensuring that every Mississippian's voice is heard, their vote is counted, and they feel valued whenever they go to the ballot box. Our Supreme Court should reflect the diversity of our state, and it is imperative that we address these disparities to uphold the principles of democracy and equality.

I’m running because the fight for Mississippians extends beyond our state’s borders. I’m ready to work for bipartisan solutions on issues like fair districts and voting laws at the federal level.

Will you work with me?

[Support our campaign to fight for fair voting laws in every zip code by contributing $20.24 or any other amount today:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90243521/489876287/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240805_b1&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2JjYzEwOTUtMzY1My1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=H5AXh3fwb-YnRB0nV4EO28t4tNy-xNkAW-HYDc5OPgI=)

name: Sarah Johnson
subject: Wish Drew a Happy Birthday! 🥳
body:
Today's Drew's birthday. Will you help me celebrate? | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drewfornevada/happy-birthday-drew-2024?e=fc26432468)
---
|
---
| | | [ ](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8c016d0f04&e=fc26432468)
---
| Peter,

I hope you'll join me in celebrating something special; Drew is turning 45 today! 🎂

To you, Drew may be just another candidate whose signs you see by the road. However, there is _so_ _much_ _more_ to Drew.

**_Drew’s tenacity and passion are just two reasons I fell in love with him._** But you should know where he gets that from. His story is proof that the American Dream is still alive today!

Drew grew up in a trailer in rural Appalachia with a single mom who worked two jobs to make ends meet. His hardworking mom, the love of his grandmother, and support from his church **_taught him the value of hard work, the importance of family, and the strength that comes from surrounding yourself with good people._ **

People ask me all the time, "What did you think when Drew said he wanted to run for Congress?" I tell them that I was his biggest supporter from Day One because **_I know he's the best, most qualified person to tackle the issues facing our nation._ **

See, **_Drew not only has the heart, but he also has the record to prove he'll fight for accountability and transparency._** And he'll fight to make it easier for working Americans to provide for their families.

Drew has spent thousands of hours poring over government budget documents to find waste, fraud, and abuse of our hard-earned tax dollars. **_He has saved taxpayers at least $60 billion - yes, billion with a "b" - of our money._**

He also **_wrote parental choice legislation_** that gave tens of thousands of low-income and minority kids the opportunity to receive a great education.
---
| **Here’s how you can help me celebrate Drew today:**

🎁 **Send a Birthday Message:** Take a moment to send Drew some birthday love! Whether it's a simple "Happy Birthday" or a note about why you're supporting the campaign, your words will mean the world to Drew.
**[Facebook](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=0394b1f75a&e=fc26432468) | [Instagram](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=f1014b4f70&e=fc26432468) | [X](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=07c42ab69f&e=fc26432468)**

🎉 **Chip In $45:** In honor of Drew's 45th, we're asking supporters to pitch in $45 – or whatever you can – to keep the momentum going. It's the perfect way to celebrate while helping Drew continue the fight.

**[CLICK HERE TO CHIP IN.](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=c0bb170dd6&e=fc26432468)**

Drew's birthday makes me reflect on all the memories we've made and successes we've shared with you – our supporters – over this past year. And I'm excited about all we'll achieve in the year ahead with your help.

**Thank you for supporting my husband and for celebrating him with me today!**

In liberty,
_Sarah_

His hardworking mom, the love of his grandmother, and support from his church taught him the value of hard work, the importance of family, and the strength that comes from surrounding yourself with good people. People ask me all the time, "What did you think when Drew said he wanted to run for Congress?" I tell them that I was his biggest supporter from Day One because I know he's the best, most qualified person to tackle the issues facing our nation. See, Drew not only has the heart, but he also has the record to prove he'll fight for accountability and transparency. And he'll fight to make it easier for working Americans to provide for their families. Drew has spent thousands of hours poring over government budget documents to find waste, fraud, and abuse of our hard-earned tax dollars. He has saved taxpayers at least $60 billion - yes, billion with a "b" - of our money. He also wrote parental choice legislation that gave tens of thousands of low-income and minority kids the opportunity to receive a great education. | Here’s how you can help me celebrate Drew today: 🎁 Send a Birthday Message: Take a moment to send Drew some birthday love! Whether it's a simple "Happy Birthday" or a note about why you're supporting the campaign, your words will mean the world to Drew. | | 🎉 Chip In $45: In honor of Drew's 45th, we're asking supporters to pitch in $45 – or whatever you can – to keep the momentum going. It's the perfect way to celebrate while helping Drew continue the fight. Drew's birthday makes me reflect on all the memories we've made and successes we've shared with you – our supporters – over this past year. And I'm excited about all we'll achieve in the year ahead with your help. Thank you for supporting my husband and for celebrating him with me today! In liberty, Sarah | | | | Copyright © 2024 Drew For Nevada, All rights reserved.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Big Domino
body:
Who is going to win in November, Donald Trump or Kamala Harris? Polls are tightening across the board with Kamala vastly outraising Trump.

https://www.andrewyang.com
Hello, I hope August is off to a great start for you and yours.

Who is going to win in November, Donald Trump or Kamala Harris? Polls are tightening across the board with Kamala vastly outraising Trump in July - $310 million to $137 million. Trump and Vance have had a couple bad weeks.

Money is a sign of momentum to be sure; the question is whether funds can translate into swing state votes in 3 months.

People ask me all of the time who I think is going to win. I personally think that the compressed time frame favors Kamala and if there is a presidential debate it will help her. The DNC will likely run a good convention that will help too – they have some appealing figures.

But I’m going to suggest that the most important variable in the race now is what RFK Jr. decides to do down the stretch.

You might have forgotten about RFK Jr. – his fortunes have declined since Kamala replaced Biden with his vote share decreasing. Still, the latest polling has him at 5% in Arizona and Michigan, 4% in Georgia, 7% in Nevada, 3% in Pennsylvania, and 6% in Wisconsin with Harris and Trump essentially tied. His vote share is more than enough to tip the election either way.

These same polls suggest that RFK’s voters now overlap more with Trump’s than with Harris’s, and that his being in the race probably helps the Dems at the margins.

In my view, RFK is one of the biggest remaining factors in this race. I believe there’s a very significant chance that he endorses Trump in the homestretch, which will likely be enough to tip the race to Trump.

RFK has been in touch with Donald Trump – video of their call was leaked - and canceled multiple days of campaign events during the RNC. It was speculated that he was going to make a surprise endorsement at the RNC in return for a position in the Trump White House.

I believe this will still happen sometime this Fall. And it will be enough to be the difference in the swing states.

Here’s the problem: I don’t think that Kamala Harris and the Democrats have it in them to call RFK and broker a similar deal. They have classified RFK as an anti-vaxxer and a kook – It’s not like they can turn around now and make him the head of the FDA. RFK, despite beginning his campaign as a Democrat, now comes across as more of an anti-establishment type. It would be more natural to see him as part of a Trump administration than a Harris team.

Kamala Harris and the Dems should be pivoting to this kind of conversation. The money will continue to flow. The ad money will be there. The challenge is to broaden the coalition to include folks who can appeal to the swing voters in the swing states. If RFK is a bridge too far, they should definitely be trying to woo Lisa Murkowski, Mitt Romney, Chris Christie and the other anti-Trumpers.

The other third party candidates – Jill Stein, Cornel West, Chase Oliver – are barely registering. RFK though has a real chance to be the biggest domino left in this race. I hope I’m wrong as to which way it’s going to fall.

To be part of the positive independent political movement dedicated to improving our choices, check out Forward (https://www.forwardparty.com/) , which is backing dozens of positive local candidates (https://home.forwardparty.com/endorsements) this November as well as ballot initiatives that could improve the primary system in Nevada, Colorado, Idaho and other states. Also this week I answered listener and reader questions on the podcast – feel free to submit your questions at mailbag@andrewyang.com (mailto:mailbag@andrewyang.com) . Next week, Freakonomics!
Andrew Yang
Co-Chair, Forward Party

Friends,
I know it's been a while since you’ve heard from me but I wanted to take a moment to reach out and check in.
Quite a bit of time has passed since we last touched base so here’s a little about what I’ve been up to: After taking a much-needed vacation with my wife, Kathy, I was honored to join the University of Chicago’s Institute of Politics as a guest lecturer for a semester where I talked about my experience as Governor of a critical battleground state and got to hear from the next generation about their outlook on our country.
**I’ve also spent the last year traveling around the state to hear from Nevadans.**
I’ve learned so much by taking the time to listen. There’s no doubt there’s a lot of anxiety about this election. From reproductive rights, to health care access, to Medicare and Social Security, down to the fundamental foundation of our nation–our democracy, Nevadans know there’s so much at stake in November.
**I have just one ask of you: Vote! Staying engaged and turning out to vote in less than 100 days will make the difference when it comes to our state’s future.** There’s never been a more important time to make our voices heard and make sure our friends and family do, too.
I’ll have more to say soon and I promise not to wait as long to reach out again.
Thank you for being one of my top supporters. I will never forget you had my back when I needed it most.
Sincerely,

Steve Sisolak
Nevada's 30th Governor

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=ce551d01b48a4a23860b03d5dfb1662d&_e=tiJNCu1j9QwZAM5dSYG3LGOm1aEZ_wir7tJQogb0LudWvH_Hvz9Albmkl0bQkXWLUMi5qRvHQfImokGSVMbSZ9DS_ZzucnCevncA4mX3FzuboZJSyhBAh9TpZDlgEgiLkZE6Djb6wl3jKTTLrAoOjA1MMS1nXrqqGwX0r5qNxRAZBOXK5Y2uPjQONMjYMIp2MDpJh0qAwsSRekqjvndIQKy7_PKDhRSuO4qIFRyIjMkIPUlaNbtJHAMmb1xhrWWrW0i4j_2t8aVIGPlXUZQa6BXqseIsBE-YYxGrYNVfIIpvZtXgkzLDxTQ7tnqVMXIumy08_N6gEwNt8pnhiloMCjWya44lKy1IclCdvhk-3F1sjER-VCPbfMuKXT_hgkAJhFE5igKCH-dGc1NyuW2cDzA-FXwvpTqbgscH2VSuUWg%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=ce551d01b48a4a23860b03d5dfb1662d&_e=tiJNCu1j9QwZAM5dSYG3LGOm1aEZ_wir7tJQogb0LudWvH_Hvz9Albmkl0bQkXWLUMi5qRvHQfImokGSVMbSZ9DS_ZzucnCevncA4mX3FzuboZJSyhBAh9TpZDlgEgiLkZE6Djb6wl3jKTTLrAoOjA1MMS1nXrqqGwX0r5qNxRAZBOXK5Y2uPjQONMjYMIp2MDpJh0qAwsSRekqjvndIQKy7_PKDhRSuO4qIFRyIjMkIPUlaNbtJHAMmb1xhrWWrW0i4j_2t8aVIGPlXUZQa6Dcc3KuOdco9x8UCFsS0dpohNC0ukQfYltJBwLCfaGZBLRaQPtADDWyQXiskUK_ppFZ5nIxhqb4HhF07RPzo0dXanFdqEJOC_HvlmG77fAz6AMmodYYoqFobQe9caTcGva4W09OvzjjyXtfqcOLj6dI%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=ce551d01b48a4a23860b03d5dfb1662d&_e=tiJNCu1j9QwZAM5dSYG3LGOm1aEZ_wir7tJQogb0LudWvH_Hvz9Albmkl0bQkXWLUMi5qRvHQfImokGSVMbSZ9DS_ZzucnCevncA4mX3FzuboZJSyhBAh9TpZDlgEgiLkZE6Djb6wl3jKTTLrAoOjA1MMS1nXrqqGwX0r5qNxRAZBOXK5Y2uPjQONMjYMIp2MDpJh0qAwsSRekqjvndIQKy7_PKDhRSuO4qIFRyIjMkIPUlaNbtJHAMmb1xhrWWrW0i4j_2t8aVIGPlXUZQa6H8HEQEmZkphlitRdRTW3aGKSplMA8xLqeD_PC-abU_pN7X_do9R3dpgaPSddr7nyh8y97xoZkF7_SjERWMgP4BSmcZO72VN2r84Y2bS6VNAiQjnWnbn9UVHEYPzoxQUVWVz_w_Oih4JC8m9NSh0hWQ%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman

**[Chip in ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240805-2?refcode=em20240805-2&recurring=1&refcode2=3775_552475_PDU1qU&akid=3775%2E552475%2EPDU1qU)**

But right-wing billionaires are coming for this Senate seat — and they’re spending a heck of a lot of money to flip it red. If they succeed, they’ll work to dismantle our democracy, women’s rights, workers’ rights, and so much more.
Bob Casey, on the other hand, is fighting for our kids, investing in our families, and working to protect family planning services like IVF. Without a doubt, this is his toughest re-election fight ever — and we need to have his back.

While serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that this was my entry point to public service — because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.

In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam — which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.

### A story about my family, our community, and how we made it.
| | [Lucas Kunce](https://substack.com/@lucaskunce)
