subject: Uniting for Victory Breakfast September 12
body:
Join fellow Republicans on Sept. 12 to unify our efforts for victory in November. Let's build a stronger, united GOP!

logo

** NHGOP United in Victory Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------

** Thursday, September 12
------------------------------------------------------------

** Doors Open 8am
------------------------------------------------------------

The primary season will soon be behind us, and it will be the time to quickly come together as one strong, united Republican team!

We are excited to invite you to the NHGOP Unity Breakfast on September 12th, where we will rally together and prepare for the critical challenges ahead on the path to November.

Event Details:

Date: Thursday, September 12, 2024
Time: Doors open 8am. Breakfast & Program 8:30am to 10:00am.
Location: Grappone Conference Center, 70 Constitution Ave Concord NH

This is our opportunity to put any differences behind us and focus on our shared goal: victory in November to keep our state SANE.

Whether you're a candidate, supporter, or volunteer, your presence is vital as we launch the final phase of our campaign. Let's show New Hampshire that the GOP is stronger and more united than ever.

Please RSVP by September 1 to ensure we have a spot for you at this important gathering.

Thank you for your commitment to our shared Republican values. Together, we will win!

Looking forward to seeing you there,

Chris Ager
Chairman, NHGOP

P.S. Let’s show the strength of a united GOP. We need everyone on board to ensure a successful November!

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1a203eecfb3040a4a0ead28d5676aa3d&_e=zX6HtoSW3XA241EHKvzA_zN0QSg4lX4kZaF2NdosKmO6PLuTxI6-4kjQJwFwYnAKsqVW-uCC880LUUTvuprxTxTXn25pka5sXuEWsytUiPo71w10qYDGFQ94zIRly2v95MtQPvz726EOB296FEnTSn7Q4wv4w-GAyoIwYuZ75fRcBsz638SmYsb080rE2C8xgX7danDDtoUtUdt1IF-NUAM1CxJshpi4f-D22uIeVGJ-2hgrZ5SSSwQhsWpDaR8s0Z7pQs0BCRFCFK9Zdv0HWq3ZAY7lP8QYCDtgbUuUB6JpxYu0Yqo2pMXq7BPVqmw0mMf8cqa-AkxzQ11yn0DmQXntRaIeqgZ_dHJCB4_q9l4Os-kUULfMP3R-YHK7g0aZM6MiV3J9BJA5XQZ89ShuNbyOp0k5WDwBrF5eqIcEwYFS2sZWBD37GkyQ_gBM6CWY) [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1a203eecfb3040a4a0ead28d5676aa3d&_e=zX6HtoSW3XA241EHKvzA_zN0QSg4lX4kZaF2NdosKmO6PLuTxI6-4kjQJwFwYnAKsqVW-uCC880LUUTvuprxTxTXn25pka5sXuEWsytUiPo71w10qYDGFQ94zIRly2v95MtQPvz726EOB296FEnTSn7Q4wv4w-GAyoIwYuZ75fRcBsz638SmYsb080rE2C8xgX7danDDtoUtUdt1IF-NUAM1CxJshpi4f-D22uIeVGJ-2hgrZ5SSSwQhsWpDaR8s0Z7pQs0BCRFCFK9Zdv0HWjoUPiuD_nparn-VYukUZyBG7iUq4x6H1LqFM1PnBDWV_gGU_sMbyXNWXoCYQkRhi54DhsiNDJ_-x_2TehK52GsVuLDNLwV9FP4nomBzEBT3XXCDIKfBPQtSpOVN7iGTTLy7_RujQGhDAuxDoaR3wS_Hee3tJyv1lmBL-nReHHhh) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1a203eecfb3040a4a0ead28d5676aa3d&_e=zX6HtoSW3XA241EHKvzA_zN0QSg4lX4kZaF2NdosKmO6PLuTxI6-4kjQJwFwYnAKsqVW-uCC880LUUTvuprxTxTXn25pka5sXuEWsytUiPo71w10qYDGFQ94zIRly2v95MtQPvz726EOB296FEnTSn7Q4wv4w-GAyoIwYuZ75fRcBsz638SmYsb080rE2C8xgX7danDDtoUtUdt1IF-NUAM1CxJshpi4f-D22uIeVGJ-2hgrZ5SSSwQhsWpDaR8s0Z7pQs0BCRFCFK9Zdv0HWircvCRAwAyXgoStuswtOxVC5RA4R0NXIkwIy2ThBvB4AgXod4UKguLSeXtnwSjOvJjF-7C2siPaCuE7coW85bWifnLpZxsGDfTS28-OCYDHTjMFuX3VTbQ3tGjMh1UsG2QT3BW18YAYI0TDOXx7c7N_8L5xOD8Jf4sTui8dRZbT)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed. This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life. Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith? clean_body: They're clearly trying to reshape the way we count our people. | Hey team — it’s Biz, President of the NDRC. I want to take a minute to talk to you all about Project 2025 — essentially a MAGA blueprint for how they're going to take over the government if Donald Trump is elected president. You’ve likely seen people talking about it all over your newsfeeds and your TV screens, but there’s one part that's not getting enough attention:the census. If Project 2025 is implemented, political actors would be installed to do what government officials have always done. The constitution says once every 10 years, the government shall count every person in the country, which plays a critical role in drawing state legislative and congressional maps — and it’s always been nonpartisan actors in charge of that count. Instead, the Project 2025 agenda wants to put forward specific individual partisan actors to decide who gets counted and who doesn't. Peter, it's a pretty scary provision. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

At the same time, it is a convenient way for the Chinese Communist Party to mask its massive [investment](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=b66dc593b9444a329c09342bda7e7bbf&_e=G1_XfnJEM2Oe0IWv0cH3h4AtWSZyar0l4Fhp7YRNz8X-B3VK-4-KNpkcnW9eKEUllZ5-z3HBU2ZnmIFbVjFN6Bfu6WBq7UkrAULeBX8Itdayb0Kn81um7ZVAyaUgIIEDdRbiLgoo2fg9g_mhPmCD6nXi1F88_AY3v1_pWn3lbZG4aaCj_vCnfZ2kLMNpWnsjbZPFggpHW1TJwqEd7FAn33H5Mi0hTFzanJG03JUwOQ29DV9M2xgfsnlXRKjH_2LJ) in nuclear weapons and avoid any serious discussion on arms control. China’s nuclear rise is putting pressure on global stability and deterrence, something that was achieved through great effort during and since the Cold War. We need leadership that sees through China’s naked self-interest and understands that it is not what Beijing says, but what it is doing that matters.

| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6b50f90c6a&e=a7ab36849c)

| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

As you may know, I was declared the winner of the State Senate race for District 2 last Wednesday evening. District 2 had a voter turnout of 48.49%. Now that the primary election is largely behind us, it’s time to get serious as the Democrats have been organizing and raising money to flip the Arizona legislature. As you may know, the legislature has a 1-seat majority in the state House and a 1-seat majority in the State Senate.

If you have a personality conflict with a particular Republican candidate running for elected office, but you know they will vote in favor of policies that you fully support, you must support those candidates to protect our freedoms and the future of our state and country. Each legislative district will be pulling together a Golden Ticket specific to its legislative district in conjunction with its Congressional District, Supervisor District and school boards. Stay tuned as they are in the works!

_Why does a Republican legislative majority matter? _

The majority party sets the legislative agenda and chooses the leadership for each chamber and selects committee chairs. As a committee chair, you are responsible for hearing or killing individual legislation assigned to that committee.

_The current governor has an enormous amount of money to help her flip the legislature blue and roll back all our legislative wins over the last several decades._

By now you know, I serve in one of the very few competitive legislative districts. Thankfully, I survived my contested primary election last week because I have the chance to defend this seat and win.

As we gear up for the November general election, I truly need your support to win in November. Do you have time to help us [write post cards](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2705f8086e&e=a7ab36849c) into our district? If you live in my district, will you display a [yard sign](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4c55cfb76a&e=a7ab36849c) in support of my candidacy? Can you [host](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7a4dba821d&e=a7ab36849c) a fundraiser or [donate](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7ba11bbd7c&e=a7ab36849c) to our campaign?

My general election opponent didn’t have a primary election. She most likely has well over $400K in the bank from mostly leftwing out-of-state ActBlue donors plus her many out of state special interest groups backing her candidacy.

Our competitive legislative district leans just slightly in favor of Republican voters,[ by 3.8%](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=db371366d3&e=a7ab36849c). This legislative district is winnable. [Can I count on your support?](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=32ce8ed1e1&e=a7ab36849c)

_Litigation Update on Mi Familia v. Adrian Fontes_

The Left continues to engage in judicial lawfare against Arizona’s proof of citizenship requirement to vote, so the Senate President is sending this case to the U.S. Supreme Court and will file an emergency stay application this week.

Last week a three-judge Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals panel voted 2-1 through a “highly irregular and strongly disfavored” procedural maneuver after two liberal judges overturned an emergency stay decision issued by a previous panel who had unanimously sided with an Arizona law I voted yes in 2022 to require proof of citizenship to cast a ballot. Thus, this will now effectively allow any individual in Arizona to use a state form to register to vote, without providing proof of citizenship to cast a ballot in federal races like U.S. President and Congress.

Federal law doesn’t currently require citizenship documentation to vote in federal elections. Congress has a bill to forbid illegals from registering to vote, but we have a divided Congress and a President who desires to allow anyone to vote in our elections. Let’s hope justice prevails so only American citizens are voting in our elections.

_Upcoming Dates to keep in mind_

October 7th is the last day to register to vote in the general election.
October 9th early voting begins, and early ballots are mailed to voters on the Active Early Voting List or those who have requested a one-time ballot by mail.
October 25th is the deadline for accepting requests for an early mail ballot.
November 1st is the deadline to vote early in-person by 7pm.
November 5th is the deadline to vote on election day in person.

In an upcoming _Capitol & Campaign_ email update, I will furnish you with specific information about the November Ballot Propositions. This morning I helped film a short video in favor of [Proposition 311, the Back the Blue](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a05492e14a&e=a7ab36849c) ballot measure and [Proposition 313,](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7565463014&e=a7ab36849c) the proposition I sponsored to best protect our minor children from being sex trafficked.

This week I will be attending my last formal meeting with the [Hunt Kean Fellows](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0359696e7a&e=a7ab36849c) program to discuss everything from AI in K-12 education to meeting with K-12 educators and university leaders.

Have a great week and let’s win this election to save the future of our state.

Best,
Shawnna

As we gear up for the November general election, there will be a lot of propositions on the ballot. If you want to volunteer this fall during the general election, the state Republican party has been actively recruiting [volunteers](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=048ecc14dd&e=a7ab36849c) to get trained to become poll observers.

If you want to volunteer with the It Goes Too Far campaign, please visit their [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b8d8edb184&e=a7ab36849c) to learn how to become more involved with their efforts.

If you would like to help donate to keep our judiciary independent, you can donate to the Judicial Independence PAC at their [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f2cf37128a&e=a7ab36849c).
